title: LIVE ICE TYPE
noaa_source: U.S. National Ice Center (NAIS) daily Great Lakes ice analysis, SIGRID-3 shapefile
product_name: U.S. National Ice Center (NAIS) daily Great Lakes ice analysis, SIGRID-3 shapefile
variable: predominant WMO stage of development (SA/SB/SC by partial concentration)
data_time_utc: NIC analysis date 2026-05-16 (from NIC filename; retrieved 2026-09-21 19:00 UTC)
spatial_resolution_source: NIC SIGRID-3 vector analysis (variable polygon size)
spatial_resolution_rendered: 1800x1175 canvas over lon [-93.0,-73.5], lat [40.5,49.5] (mean-value binning, no upsampling of source precision)
missing_data_treatment: open water (CT<1) fully transparent; unknown/unstaged ice gets the explicit Unknown color, never a real type color.
attribution: Data: US NOAA. This project is not endorsed by NOAA. See DATA_SOURCES.md for exact products and endpoints.
data_nature: analyzed (human ice analysis of satellite imagery)
methodology: Per SIGRID-3 polygon: predominant stage = highest partial concentration among SA/SB/SC (ties resolve to the thickest-listed stage); rendered in that stage's fixed key color with pixel alpha scaled by total concentration CT/10. The key lists every WMO stage the dataset supports.
